package.description: Context-aware AI prompt help that learns how you work. Private by design; your data is never sold.

en-US.description: Context-aware AI prompt help that learns how you work. Private by design; your data is never sold.
en-US.longDescription:
Wysely is a desktop companion that makes the AI you already use give you
better answers by knowing your context. Press one hotkey anywhere you type —
a browser chat, a desktop AI app, an editor — and Wysely reads your draft,
points out what is missing, and can rewrite it with your role, voice and
goals already built in.

It is built privacy-first. Instant on-device analysis is free and unmetered,
and works offline: it never sends your draft anywhere. Improvement telemetry
is consented and your data is never sold. Optional AI rewrites run
server-side on a weekly allowance. A personal prompt library with reusable
presets and short plain-English tips help you need the tool less over time.
en-US.name: Wysely
